name: @cat-factory/acceptance-kit
description: Building blocks for writing your own HEADLESS acceptance suite against a live cat-factory deployment: the scenario driver, the resumable ledger and progress journal, a prerequisite gate whose refusals carry rendered remedies, waits that state their last observation, and an SDK-driven run driver that answers only the decisions a suite was designed for. The platform's own acceptance suite is built from it, so a deployment can cover its own providers, agent kinds and gates the same way.
